provenance.method: Loaded and answered Separate Audio at int8: one ordinary Load, then two Separate Audio requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Separate Audio requests on a 3.3 s speech-and-music clip.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Separate Audio requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Separate Audio request on a 3.3 s speech-and-music clip.

provenance.method: Wall time of the timed (second) Separate Audio request, one sample, after one ordinary Load, then two Separate Audio requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; includes the API round trip. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.
